Creates a raster with the highest, or lowest, elevation of the lidar points in each cell: a surface model without interpolation.

**Toolbox folder:** Lesto › raster<br>
**Status:** Draft<br>
**Keywords:** raster, lidar<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.lesto.modules.raster.LasOnRasterMapper`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inLas` | LAS file |  |  | The lidar data: a las file, the index file of a folder of las files created by LasIndexer or a las database. |
| `inDtm` | raster file |  |  | The elevation model of the ground: it gives the area and the grid, and the lowest value of the cells. |
| `pXres` | Double |  |  | The x resolution of the raster. If not supplied, the one of the elevation model is used. |
| `pYres` | Double |  |  | The y resolution of the raster. If not supplied, the one of the elevation model is used. |
| `doMax` | boolean |  | `true` | If true, the highest point of each cell is mapped, if false the lowest. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outRaster` | output file |  | The raster of the elevation of the points. |
| `outDtm` | output file |  | The optional output of the elevation model on the grid of the raster, to compare them cell by cell. |
